value.rationale: The multiplicative image and minimum length of constrained trace-coefficient sets are natural structural invariants for fixed-norm irreducible quadratics. The sharp two-element obstruction, mod-four transition, all-prime-power generality, and unique exceptional field go beyond a routine enumerative test.
